text: Coffee with Mai. Her dad's funeral is Thursday at the crem, wake at the Fox afterwards. She's holding up but exhausted. Chiara's driving her there. Text Mai the night before, just so she knows I'm thinking of her. Her aunt is flying in from Hanoi on Wednesday, which Mai's dreading a bit because they don't get on. Maybe offer to sit with her at the wake.

Long call with Wiremu. He got made redundant on Monday, along with half his team. His wife Georgia is being really supportive. He's got a meeting with HR next Tuesday about the package. Need to ring him the day after. He kept saying he's fine but he clearly isn't, and their eldest starts uni next year so money's a worry. He'd quite like help with his CV too.
Liam's new manager sounds a nightmare. Micromanages everything, cc's his boss on every email. Liam's thinking about leaving by Christmas.

Isabel and Akira split up. Been coming for a while apparently. She's moving back in with her mum this weekend. Akira's keeping the flat and the dog, Biscuit. Don't forget to check in with Isabel next week.
Rory says the client pitch got moved to Friday. He's presenting and properly nervous, hasn't slept. Thomas is doing the numbers bit. Send Rory a good luck message that morning.
Lunch with Imogen. Her grandad died last week, ninety-four. Funeral's on the 3rd but she's not sure she can get the time off work.
Jen wants to meet up in a fortnight, maybe the Thai place. She's off sugar at the moment so no dessert talk.
Karan's leaving do is next Friday at the Crown. Twelve years at the firm! Anil's collecting for a card and present. I should chip in and sign it before Wednesday.

Caught up with Hassan after the meeting. His boss Mrs Okafor is retiring in December and he might be up for her role. Interview's the week after half term. He seemed calm about it, honestly. Ask him afterwards how it went. Also, Mrs Okafor's leaving lunch is on the 12th and Karan's organising it, so I should tell Karan I'm in.

Georgia's mum passed on Saturday. Peaceful, at home. Funeral probably the following Friday, Georgia's flying back to Lisbon the day before. Her brother Pedro is sorting most of the arrangements. Send flowers to her place tomorrow, and maybe drop off a lasagne when she's back.
Carmen says the Ahmed account is moving to another agency. Not her fault but she's gutted.
Astrid's birthday Sunday. She's been dropping hints about a new pair of running headphones.
Teresa got the promotion! Starts as team lead on the 1st. Her partner Yaw is taking her out to celebrate Saturday night.
Salma's wedding's off. She and Milan broke up last month, she only told me today. She's staying with her sister Aoife for a bit. Call her on Sunday when it's quiet.
Tomás reckons the restructure announcement is Tuesday. Everyone's on edge. His colleague Andile already has an interview elsewhere on Thursday.
Picking up the suit from the dry cleaner tomorrow, then the train up for Gran's memorial on Saturday. Back Sunday night.
Rhys and his wife Kavya are going to Japan for three weeks in April. First proper holiday since the twins. He's after recommendations for Kyoto. Must send him that list from Archie.

Julien was really quiet at five-a-side. Turns out his dad's been in hospital since Wednesday, heart thing. Surgery scheduled for Monday. Message him Monday evening to see how it went, and offer a lift if he needs one.
Siobhan's grumbling about a client again, the one who rings at 7am. She loves the job otherwise. She's doing a pottery course on Tuesday nights now.
Zeynep called. Her nan's cat Pasha died, nan's devastated. Zeynep is going round tomorrow to keep her company.
Need to post the condolence card to Mr Lewis before Friday. Funeral is the Monday after.
Mai asked if I can help her clear out her dad's flat next weekend. Already said yes. Her cousin Wiremu is bringing the van.

Chiara's leaving the company! Last day is the 14th. She's going to a startup, smaller but much better money. Her manager Thomas had no idea until Monday. Leaving drinks probably the Thursday before. She's a bit nervous about the move but mostly excited. Don't forget to get her something, she's mentioned wanting a decent notebook for the new job.
Liam's partner Rory got let go from the bank yesterday. Liam says he's putting a brave face on.

FaceTime with Isabel. She's settled at her mum's. Starting therapy next week, which she's nervous about. Her mum's been brilliant. Akira hasn't been in touch at all, which she says is fine. I should visit before the end of the month, maybe the weekend after next. Her mum said to bring the boys, she'd love to see them. Take that board game Isabel liked.
Akira messaged out of nowhere. He's moving to Leeds in November for a new job. Wants a goodbye pint before he goes. Sort a date with him this week.
Thomas has his annual review on Thursday and expects it to go badly. His boss, Dr Baker, apparently never gives top marks.
Imogen went to the funeral in the end. Said it was lovely, lots of stories about her grandad's allotment. She's taking a few days off now. Remind me to text her Friday.
Jen and her husband Anil are hosting a housewarming on the 22nd. New place in Didsbury, garden's huge. Bring something veggie, Anil doesn't eat meat.
Karan says Hassan's interview went really well and they told him on the spot. He's the new head of ops from January! Congratulate Hassan tomorrow.
Quick one from the call with Georgia. Funeral was yesterday and it went OK. She's staying in Lisbon another week to help Pedro sort the house. Lisbon's grey apparently.

Lunch with Carmen and Astrid. Carmen's applying for the senior role internally, deadline next Monday. Astrid just got back from Iceland, saw the northern lights twice. Carmen's cat Luna had an operation last week but is recovering fine.
Teresa's dad has his scan results on Wednesday. She's very anxious. Her brother Milan is going with him. Ring Teresa that evening.
Yaw says the office party is cancelled this year, budget cuts. Instead there's a team lunch on the 18th.
Salma's back at work. Seems better, still not sleeping much. Her manager's been decent about it.

Meeting Tomás for breakfast on Wednesday before his flight to Madrid. His mum's not well and he's going to be with her for a fortnight. He wants to borrow my big suitcase. Bring it Wednesday. His boss has been good about compassionate leave, thankfully. His girlfriend Carmen is joining him out there the second week. Tomás said the hardest bit is not knowing how long they've got.
Andile got the job! Starts the Monday after next, so he's handing his notice in tomorrow. His wife Siobhan is relieved, it's been a tough year since the redundancy.

Kavya is nervous about her first marathon in Berlin, Sunday 27th. She's done all the training but her knee is playing up. Rhys and the kids are going to cheer her on. Text her good luck the day before.
Archie's dog Mabel had to be put down yesterday. Fourteen years old. He's not really talking about it. I should pop round at the weekend with a bottle.
Julien's dad came through the surgery fine. Home by Friday, they hope. Julien sounded so relieved.
Had the quarterly with Pedro and his team. Their new hire, Kim, is sharp. Pedro's off on paternity leave from next Tuesday, baby due any day. Must send a card for the baby.
Aoife and Siobhan were both at the funeral. Aoife's moving to Galway in spring to be nearer their dad. Siobhan is staying put.
Zeynep's sister Kavya is graduating Friday. Whole family's going. Zeynep wants ideas for a present, Kavya loves anything to do with tea.
Booked the dentist for Thursday morning. Then the bank about the mortgage at two.

Wiremu sounds better. He's got two interviews lined up, one Tuesday and one the Friday after. Georgia's back working full time to keep things ticking over. Wiremu mentioned he'd love to go fishing again, haven't been since uni. Maybe take him out to the lake once the interviews are done.
Mai's back at work Monday. She asked me not to make a fuss. Her colleague Liam is covering her shifts till then.
Call with Rory about the client. They want everything redone by Friday, Thomas is furious. Rory reckons we'll need the whole weekend. I'm doing the slides Saturday.
Imogen's mum has her hip op next Thursday. Imogen's staying with her for the week after to help. Don't forget to ask Imogen how her mum's getting on.
Hassan and his fiancée Salma Petrov have set the wedding for June. Not this June, next. Venue's a barn near Bath.

Spoke to Karan. His uncle passed away in Delhi on Sunday. He's flying out tonight, back in about ten days. Cover his Thursday meeting with the client. Email him a week after he's back to see how he's doing.
Chiara's first week at the startup: chaos but fun. Her new boss is younger than her. Drinks with her and Isabel next Saturday.
Astrid broke up with her girlfriend Teresa over the summer, I only just heard. They're still friendly. Astrid's thinking about moving to Copenhagen next year.
Milan says his manager Mr Suzuki is leaving in a month and nobody knows who's replacing him. Milan's hoping for an acting role, fingers crossed.

Pedro's baby arrived Sunday, a girl, Inês! Mum and baby both doing well. He's on leave till the new year. Chip in for the team gift before Friday. Pedro's partner wants nothing pink apparently, so maybe the little yellow dungarees from that shop on the high street. He says he's surviving on about three hours of sleep and loving it.
Andile asked if I can be a reference. Yes, obviously. Need to reply to the HR email by tomorrow.

Long chat with Siobhan in the car park. Her dad's diagnosis came back, early stage. Treatment starts in a fortnight, she's going with him to the first session. She's coping but only just. Her brother Rhys is useless apparently, never calls. She mentioned she's been reading loads to switch off, mostly crime. Order her the new Tana French and drop it round this weekend.
Yaw's daughter starts nursery Monday. He's more nervous than she is.
Groceries, then the post office. Return the jacket before Saturday.
Julien and Aoife are getting married in Lyon next September! Engaged at the weekend. Save the dates going out after Christmas.

Rough day for Archie. His team's being merged and there's a consultation meeting on Friday. His boss won't tell anyone anything. Call Archie after the meeting Friday. Maybe suggest a pint this weekend whichever way it goes.
